Rat heart

Two heart peptides
ANP28 amino acids, from the atria
BNP32 amino acids, mainly from the ventricles

The trigger

Stretch.

Extra fluid stretches the heart wall. ANP is released.

What ANP does
1More salt and water out
2Relaxed blood vessels
